name: q3_01_workflow

name: q3_02_routes_relays
claim: The verified plan uses 21 transport sorties and three terrain-aware relay positions.

name: q3_03_joint_schedule
claim: Relay service must begin before the first required communication interval and last through the final one.

name: q3_04_communication
claim: All 240 continuous communication intervals have an available direct gateway or an active relay.

name: q3_05_deliveries
claim: All 80 boxes meet their expected deadlines, including all 31 hard deadlines.

name: q3_06_resources
claim: Aircraft turnaround and energy-resource recharge are checked separately without resource overlap.

name: q3_07_margins
claim: Every hard deadline and return-energy reserve passes under the specified physical model.

name: q3_08_comparison
claim: The 22-transport alternative saves energy but has a higher frozen weighted score due to one extra sortie.
